ns2:course.label: Design of Social Work Research
ns2:course.description: This course is intended for students in the Ph.D. program in Social Work. Issues and problems in social work research design. Includes review of the research process; quantitative, qualitative, and evaluative research methodologies; critical assessment and use of measurement instruments; design of original research study, and the art of research proposal writing Prerequisite: Admission to Ph.D. program
